Квантовые маяки публикуют результаты физ: Quantum beacons publish the results of physical measurements. We sample their pulses every five minutes. If a day's events unfold differently, the sequence of outcomes may differ. One pulse marks only a moment; the daily fingerprint combines hundreds of pulses with solar wind data.
